name: Bursa and Cumalıkızık: the Birth of the Ottoman Empire
description: Bursa, in northwestern Türkiye beneath Mount Uludağ, was the first capital of the Ottoman Empire in the 14th century. Its historic core still holds bustling merchant khans, mosque complexes with schools, baths and a soup kitchen for the poor, and the tomb of dynasty founder Orhan Ghazi. Nearby Cumalıkızık is a village that once fed the city.
